sourceNameRequired: Enter a name for the source.
seatsTooFew: {count, plural, one {A workspace needs at least # seat.} other {A workspace needs at least # seats.}}
pickTeamToShare: Pick a team to share with.
linkInvalid: Enter the full link, starting with https://
checkForm: Something in the request isn’t right. Reload the page and try again.
notMember: This workspace doesn’t exist, or you aren’t a member of it.
suspended: This workspace is suspended. Its owner can contact support to restore it.
adminsChangeSettings: Only admins can change workspace settings.
adminsRevokeInvitation: Only admins can revoke this invitation.
adminsAddToTeam: Only admins can add people to this team.
sendFilesAsForm: Send the files as multipart form data.
tooManyFiles: {count, plural, one {Add at most # file at once.} other {Add at most # files at once.}}
teamsGone: One of the teams no longer exists.
knowledgeGone: This is no longer shared in the workspace.
knowledgeChangeDenied: Only the person who added it or an admin can change it.
knowledgeRemoveDenied: Only the person who added it or an admin can remove it.
allAlreadyInvited: Everyone on the list is already in the workspace or invited.
seatsLeft: {count, plural, =0 {No seats left. Add seats to invite more people.} one {Only # seat left. Add seats to invite more people.} other {Only # seats left. Add seats to invite more people.}}
invitationGone: This invitation was already accepted or revoked.
personGone: This person is no longer in the workspace.
peopleGone: One of the people is no longer in the workspace.
leadGone: The lead is no longer in the workspace.
roleChangeDenied: You can’t change this person’s role.
meetingNotFound: This meeting doesn’t exist or isn’t shared with you.
recordingNotFound: This recording isn’t yours, or it no longer exists.
meetingShareDenied: Only the organizer or an admin can change who sees this meeting.
meetingUnshareDenied: Only the organizer or an admin can take this meeting out of the workspace.
projectEditDenied: Only the project lead or an admin can edit it.
projectDeleteDenied: Only the project lead or an admin can delete it.
taskNotFound: This task doesn’t exist or isn’t shared with you.
ownerOnlyDelete: Only the owner can delete the workspace.
ownerCantLeave: The owner can’t leave. Delete the workspace instead.
teamHasKnowledge: Move this team’s knowledge to another team or to everyone before deleting it.
